units.source_text: 次日天又降雪，四周景色萧瑟。

en.t: The next day snow fell again, and the scenery all around was bleak and desolate.

units.source_text: 源氏与紫姬共话往昔，预计将来。

en.t: Genji and Lady Murasaki talked together of the past and considered what lay ahead.

units.source_text: 源氏乘机言道：“朱雀院病势转重，

en.t: Seizing the moment, Genji said, "The Suzaku Retired Emperor's illness has grown worse,

units.source_text: 我昨天前去慰问，岂知他有无限伤心之事呢：

en.t: and when I went yesterday to pay my respects, I found that he was burdened with boundless sorrow:

units.source_text: 他异常关怀三公主的终身大事，向我提出了如此这般的嘱托。

en.t: he is deeply concerned about the Third Princess's future and entrusted me with this request.

units.source_text: 我很可怜他，觉得未便拒绝，只得接受。

en.t: I pitied him greatly, and feeling that I could not properly refuse, I had no choice but to accept.

units.source_text: 外人想必已在大肆宣扬了。

en.t: People outside have surely already begun spreading the matter far and wide.

units.source_text: 我如今风月情怀早已消减，对此等事不复深感兴趣。

en.t: By now my romantic impulses have long since faded, and such matters no longer interest me deeply.

units.source_text: 所以他屡次央人转达，我都托故婉谢。

en.t: That is why, though he repeatedly had others convey his wishes, I made excuses and declined politely.

units.source_text: 但在当面罄谈衷曲之时亲口提出，我实在不忍断然拒绝。

en.t: But when he spoke to me face to face and poured out his heart, I truly could not bring myself to refuse him outright.

units.source_text: 到了朱雀院移居深山之时，即当迎接三公主来此。

en.t: When the Suzaku Retired Emperor moves to his retreat deep in the mountains, I am to welcome the Third Princess here.

units.source_text: 你听了这话很不高兴么？

en.t: Are you very displeased to hear this?

units.source_text: 我告诉你：即使有天大的事情，我爱你的心决不改变，请你不要介意。

en.t: Let me tell you this: no matter how great a matter may arise, my love for you will never change, so please do not take it to heart.

units.source_text: 此事在三公主反而是委屈的，所以我也未便太冷遇她。

en.t: In fact, this situation is unfair to the Third Princess, so I cannot treat her too coldly either.

units.source_text: 总之，但愿大家平安度日。”

en.t: In any case, I only hope that everyone may pass the days in peace."

units.source_text: 紫姬生性善妒，往日源氏略有轻薄行为，她就视为不端而对他生气。

en.t: Lady Murasaki was jealous by nature, and in the past, whenever Genji behaved even a little frivolously, she took it as misconduct and became angry with him.

units.source_text: 所以今天源氏很担心，不知她对此事有何表示。

en.t: Therefore Genji was very anxious today, not knowing how she would respond to this matter.

units.source_text: 岂知紫姬满不在乎，从容答道：“这个嘱托，出于一片苦心，真正教人感动啊！

en.t: Unexpectedly, Lady Murasaki appeared wholly unconcerned and answered calmly, "This request comes from such heartfelt concern that it is truly moving.

units.source_text: 我哪里会介意呢！

en.t: How could I possibly take offense?

units.source_text: 只要她不看轻我，不讨厌我住在这里，我就安心了。

en.t: As long as she does not look down on me or dislike my living here, I shall be at ease.

units.source_text: 她的母亲藤壶女御是我的姑母，有这关系，想来她不会疏远我吧？”

en.t: Her mother, Lady Fujitsubo, is my aunt, so with that connection I imagine she will not keep me at a distance."

units.source_text: 源氏料不到她如此谦逊，说道：“你太忠厚宽大了，是何用意，反而教我担心。

en.t: Genji had not expected such humility from her and said, "You are so sincere and generous that I find myself wondering what you mean by it, and that worries me.

units.source_text: 诚能如此居心，宽大为怀，则在己在人，两皆安乐。

en.t: If you can truly keep such a heart and remain broad-minded, both you and others will be at peace.

units.source_text: 你若能与她和睦相处，则我一定更疼爱你。

en.t: If you can live harmoniously with her, I shall surely love you all the more.

units.source_text: 今后外人倘有谣言，你切不可信以为真。

en.t: If outsiders spread rumors from now on, you must never believe them to be true.

units.source_text: 所有世人谣言，大都毫无根据，总是把人家男女之间的事胡言乱道，以致歪曲实情，因而发生意外之事。

en.t: Most worldly rumors have no basis at all; people always talk nonsense about relations between men and women, twisting the truth and causing unexpected trouble.

units.source_text: 所以必须平心静气，观察实情，方为贤明。

en.t: Therefore one must keep a calm mind and observe the facts; only then is one wise.

units.source_text: 切不可急切暴躁，徒自怨恨。”

en.t: You must not grow impatient and agitated, or resent things to no purpose."

units.source_text: 他恳切地对她开导了一番。

en.t: He earnestly counseled her for some time.

units.source_text: 紫姬心中想道：“这件事出乎意外，仿佛是空中掉下来的。

en.t: Lady Murasaki thought to herself, "This matter is completely unexpected, as though it had fallen from the sky.

units.source_text: 他既然无法避免，我也不必反对，徒然被他讨厌。

en.t: Since he cannot avoid it, there is no need for me to oppose him and merely make him dislike me.

units.source_text: 倘是他和三公主两人真心发生恋情，则他对我必然有所顾忌，或者必能听从我的劝谏而中止；

en.t: If he and the Third Princess had truly fallen in love, he would surely have some regard for me, and perhaps he would listen to my remonstrance and stop;

units.source_text: 惟今次之事并非如此，使我无法阻止。

en.t: but this time the matter is not like that, and it leaves me unable to prevent it.

units.source_text: 但不可使世人知道我有无益的怨恨。

en.t: Still, I must not let the world know that I harbor useless resentment.

units.source_text: 我的继母——式部卿亲王的正夫人——常常在诅咒我，甚至为了那讨厌的髭黑大将的事件，也莫名其妙地怪怨了我。

en.t: My stepmother, the principal wife of Prince Shikibukyo, is always cursing me, and she even blamed me quite unreasonably for that hateful affair with General Higekuro.

units.source_text: 如今她闻知此事，定在幸灾乐祸了。”

en.t: Now that she has heard of this, she must surely be rejoicing at my misfortune."

units.source_text: 紫姬虽然是个胸襟开朗的人，但此时岂能无动于衷。

en.t: Although Lady Murasaki was a broad-minded person, how could she remain unmoved at such a time?

units.source_text: 近年来夫妇之间平安无事，她的地位安如磐石，她以为从此可以坐享唱随之乐了；

en.t: In recent years all had been peaceful between husband and wife, and her position had seemed firm as a rock; she had thought she could henceforth enjoy the harmony of married life.

units.source_text: 岂料今又发生了叫人耻笑之事。

en.t: Yet now, unexpectedly, another matter had arisen that would invite people's ridicule.

units.source_text: 她心中私下愁叹，但外表十分镇静。

en.t: Inwardly she grieved and sighed in private, but outwardly she remained perfectly composed.
